morgan: Quick question about rerank billing when we batch requests :thinking:

morgan: Suppose client A sends 3 parallel rerank calls each with 10 candidates. Our runtime batches them into one GPU job. Do we bill 30 candidate-scores or something else?

dan: We bill by logical scoring operations, not GPU jobs. So that would be 30 scoring units today. Batching only optimizes latency/cost under the hood, it doesn't collapse quota.

priya: Is that still true if two requests share identical candidate vectors and we dedupe at the router?

dan: If identical candidates were deduped at the scoring layer we could avoid double-charging, but we don't do that dedupe across requests today. The router collapse we do is only for routing metadata, not content dedupe.

kevin: To be explicit, current formula is roughly: charge = sum_over_requests(num_candidates * per_candidate_unit). top_k doesn't change the charge if you submit full candidate list; if you submit n and ask top_k < n we still scored n internally.

kevin: Example request shapes:
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "q text",
  "candidates": [{"id": "a","text":"..."}, {"id":"b","text":"..."}, ...]
}
```

kevin: If 3 requests each have 10 candidates -> accounting = 3 * 10 = 30 scoring ops. If we had aggregated at the application layer into one request with 10 unique candidates and a mapping of queries -> candidates we could be charged differently, but we don't expose that interface.

priya: Ok makes sense. We should surface the effective charged units in the console. Current dashboards only show tokens and inference-time cost.

morgan: Agree — proposal: add metric `rerank.scoring_units` and expose per-route breakdown and per-batch_size histogram. That would help customers tune batch sizes vs request pattern.

infra-bot: Note: deploy of routing v2 will change handling of identical request signatures, but it won't change per-candidate charging. See release 2026-03-18.

dan: Long-term idea: offer a dedupe mode for rerank where identical candidate text across a time-window gets cached and not recharged. Would need telemetry, correctness tests, and a config knob per-customer.

priya: Also consider exposing an estimation API so SDK can show "estimated scoring units" before send. UX: small tooltip in console and quick preflight endpoint.

morgan: Filing follow-up issue to eng-platform backlog with action items: dashboard metric, expose estimate endpoint, and review routing v2 docs. @@kevin can you add the sample numbers? :+1:

kevin: Yep will add numbers and a small simulation job to the issue.

morgan: Thanks — closing the loop for now. :raised_hands:
